Augment Data with mvr Fitted Values

Source: R/tidy_mvr.R
augment.Rd

augment.mvr adds fitted values and residuals to the model frame (or to newdata, for fitted values only).

Usage

augment(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mvr'
augment(x, data = NULL, ncomp = x$ncomp, ...)

Arguments

x

an object.

...

further arguments passed to methods.

data

optional data frame to augment. If omitted, the model frame is used.

ncomp

positive integer. Number of components used for predictions.

Value

A data frame with added prediction columns.

Examples

data(yarn)
d <- yarn[1:20, , drop = FALSE]
mod <- plsr(density ~ NIR, ncomp = 2, data = d)

aug_train <- augment(mod)
